steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ and open its configuration drawer.
Give the unsaved event a unique title so its absence can be checked later.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.

args.goal: on the Single Stage RFQ create screen, click Cancel in the Configuration for Event window; stop on the create screen after the window is closed without saving or creating the event

steps.note: Perform the configuration cancellation that no dedicated catalog action exposes.
Verify the configuration window is closed.
Return to the events list to check that cancellation created nothing.
Verify the events list rendered without an application error.
Assert that the cancelled event does not appear in the events list.
